hebrewText: קְחִ֥י רֵחַ֖יִם וְ/טַ֣חֲנִי קָ֑מַח גַּלִּ֨י צַמָּתֵ֧/ךְ חֶשְׂפִּי שֹׁ֛בֶל גַּלִּי שׁ֖וֹק עִבְרִ֥י נְהָרֽוֹת

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.

tokens.bdb: to grind meal; hence, to be aconcubine (that being their employment)
to denude (especially in a disgraceful sense); by implication, to exile (captives being usually stripped); figuratively, to reveal
tokens.kjv: [phrase] advertise, appear, bewray, bring, (carry, lead, go) captive (into captivity), depart, disclose, discover, exile, be gone, open, [idiom] plainly, publish, remove, reveal, [idiom] shamelessly, shew, [idiom] surely, tell, uncover.

tokens.bdb: to strip off, i.e. generally to make naked (for exertion or in disgrace), to drain away or bail up (a liquid)
tokens.kjv: make bare, clean, discover, draw out, take, uncover.
